title: Special Topics in Management and Organization; Leadership Excellence - The Disney Difference
description: Course restricted to BMGT majors and General Business minors. This course requires travel to Orlando, FL from March 13-16, 2025 and requires payment of a non-refundable $809 course fee that covers lodgingand access to Disney parks. Students are responsible for travel and additional expenses. This course has a limited drop period. Contact ncottre@umd.edu for more information.
